# Medieval Knight - rigged for UE4/5 (simplified static sample)

Author: **Andy Woodhead**.
Original: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/medieval-knight-rigged-for-ue45-1c7a83c0832a4ab28d9f1a46d282fcf9
License: **Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International**,
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ . Credit the original author.

Downloaded 2026-11-04 from the publicly offered simplified sample:
https://afk.ai/rig/samples/crusader-knight.glb
Distributor's author/license statement: https://afk.ai/samples

The downloaded copy is static, with six textured mesh groups and no skeleton or
animation clips. It is not the full original UE-rigged download. This project
normalizes orientation/scale, separates limb triangles into procedural pivots,
adapts rest pose/material response and attaches the original sword to the existing
combat pivot. Original UVs and normal maps are preserved. This is not an animation
retarget or a claim of original authorship. No endorsement is implied.

Runtime adapter: game/presentation/scanned_knight.gd. The earlier original procedural
knight builder and its GLB snapshots remain available as fallback/editable originals.
The original CC-BY file remains intact for provenance; modifications happen in code.

The shared static adapter also presents Sir Cael (waiting NPC and active companion),
with an original blue cloak. The same attribution applies; no new source download.
